heroHeading: Get Instant Insights from Any SEC Filing
heroSubheading: Discover critical information effortlessly, saving hours of manual analysis.

faqItems.question: What does your service do?
faqItems.answer: We provide instant insights from SEC filings using advanced AI-powered models, saving you hours of manual analysis.

faqItems.question: How does the AI-powered model work?
faqItems.answer: Our AI model leverages retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) technology to deliver accurate, contextual insights from SEC filings based on your queries.

faqItems.question: Can I search for any public company's filings?
faqItems.answer: Yes, we offer access to filings for any public company, with an extensive library of up-to-date documents.

faqItems.question: How do I start using the service?
faqItems.answer: Simply sign up, choose a filing of interest, and start interacting with our AI model to extract key insights quickly.

faqItems.question: What types of insights can I get?
faqItems.answer: You can get a wide range of insights, including financial summaries, risk factors, and detailed answers to specific questions about a filing.

faqItems.question: What are the subscription options?
faqItems.answer: We offer both monthly and annual subscription plans, with a discount on the annual plan where you get two months free.

faqItems.question: What makes your service different from other search tools?
faqItems.answer: Unlike traditional search tools, our AI model provides contextual insights, making it easier to understand complex filings without missing critical information.

faqItems.question: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
faqItems.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time through your account settings.

faqItems.question: How do I get support if I encounter any issues?
faqItems.answer: You can reach out to us through email with any questions or issues you encounter, or send us a direct message through LinkedIn.
